topics.name: CPU Scheduler Simulator
topics.concept: CPU schedulers decide which process runs next, with FCFS, SJF, round robin, and priority each optimizing different goals. The simulator runs process sets through each algorithm measuring wait and turnaround times. Scheduling policy becomes visible arithmetic.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates process mixes.

topics.name: Multilevel Feedback Queue
topics.concept: MLFQ adapts to unknown burst times by demoting CPU hogs and promoting interactive jobs, approximating SJF without knowing the future. The simulator shows jobs migrating between queues. It is the scheduler behind many real systems.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mixes interactive and batch jobs.

topics.name: Context Switch Estimator
topics.concept: Context switches cost cache pollution and TLB flushes, so the estimator models overhead against quantum size. It shows why tiny quanta waste CPU on switching. Responsiveness has a price.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG varies quanta and workloads.

topics.name: Deadlock Detector
topics.concept: Deadlocks need mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, and circular wait; breaking any prevents them. The detector builds resource allocation graphs finding cycles. It catches the embrace before it is fatal.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates allocation states with cycles.

topics.name: Bankers Safety Checker
topics.concept: The banker's algorithm grants requests only when a safe sequence exists, simulating allocation before committing. The checker walks requests through the safety test. Conservative allocation, proven safe.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates claims and requests.

topics.name: Mutex Semaphore Lab
topics.concept: Mutexes guard critical sections while semaphores count resources, and misusing them causes races or deadlocks. The lab runs threads with correct and buggy synchronization showing outcomes. Concurrency primitives, hands-on.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG interleaves thread execution.

topics.name: Reader Writer Simulator
topics.concept: Readers can share access but writers need exclusivity, with fairness policies preventing starvation. The simulator runs reader and writer mixes under preference policies. Shared data stays consistent.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG issues read and write requests.

topics.name: Dining Philosophers OS
topics.concept: The OS-flavored philosophers demonstrate deadlock with fork mutexes and solutions via ordering or a waiter semaphore. The simulator compares strategies measuring throughput. The classic, executable.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG paces philosophers.

topics.name: Producer Consumer OS
topics.concept: Bounded buffers need a mutex plus empty and full semaphores, the pattern behind every queue. The simulator shows buffer levels with correct synchronization. The OS workhorse pattern.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG paces production.

topics.name: Memory Allocator Sim
topics.concept: Allocators place variable requests into free blocks with first, best, and worst fit, fragmenting differently. The simulator tracks fragmentation under each strategy. malloc's hidden complexity.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG issues allocation patterns.

topics.name: Paging Simulator
topics.concept: Paging divides memory into fixed frames mapping virtual pages through page tables. The simulator translates addresses showing table walks and faults. Virtual memory's foundation.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates address traces with locality.

topics.name: Page Replacement OS Lab
topics.concept: When frames fill, FIFO, LRU, optimal, and clock choose victims differently, with Belady's anomaly haunting FIFO. The lab replays reference strings counting faults per policy. The OS decides what to forget.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds reference strings.

topics.name: TLB Hit Estimator
topics.concept: TLBs cache translations making hits fast and misses expensive, so hit rate dominates memory performance. The estimator models TLB size and associativity against traces. A tiny cache with huge impact.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates page access patterns.

topics.name: Copy On Write Simulator
topics.concept: Fork copies page tables marking pages shared read-only, copying only on write, making process creation cheap. The simulator shows sharing and fault-driven copies. Efficient process birth.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG writes after forking.

topics.name: Zombie Reaper Monitor
topics.concept: Zombies are dead processes awaiting parental wait, and orphans get adopted by init. The monitor simulates process trees with exit and wait showing reaping. Process lifecycle hygiene.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG kills processes randomly.

topics.name: Signal Dispatcher Sim
topics.concept: Signals interrupt processes asynchronously, with handlers, masks, and default actions. The simulator delivers signals showing masking and pending states. Unix's interrupt mechanism.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG sends signals to processes.

topics.name: Inode Filesystem Sim
topics.concept: Inodes store metadata with direct and indirect block pointers, separating names from data. The simulator creates files showing block allocation. Unix filesystem anatomy.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates and deletes files.

topics.name: Journaling Simulator
topics.concept: Journaling writes intentions before data, replaying after crashes for consistency. The simulator crashes mid-operation showing recovery. Filesystems that survive power loss.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG crashes during writes.

topics.name: Disk Scheduler OS Lab
topics.concept: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, and C-SCAN order disk requests minimizing seek time. The lab animates head movement per algorithm. Elevator algorithms for spinning rust.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG queues requests.

topics.name: RAID Calculator
topics.concept: RAID levels trade capacity, performance, and fault tolerance: striping, mirroring, and parity. The calculator sizes arrays showing usable space and failure survival. Storage math that matters.
topics.data_idea: Array configs derive from inputs.

topics.name: Swap Space Monitor
topics.concept: Swapping extends memory to disk at steep performance cost, and thrashing means the system pages itself to death. The monitor tracks swap rates alerting on thrashing. The last resort, watched.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG ramps memory pressure.

topics.name: OOM Killer Policy Sim
topics.concept: When memory exhausts, the OOM killer sacrifices processes by badness score. The simulator scores processes selecting victims under policies. The kernel's grim triage.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG grows memory usage.

topics.name: Cgroup Limiter Sim
topics.concept: Cgroups cap CPU, memory, and IO per group, the mechanism behind containers. The simulator enforces limits throttling overuse. Resource control, kernel-enforced.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives group demands.

topics.name: Syscall Tracer Sim
topics.concept: Strace-style tracing logs system calls revealing what programs actually do. The simulator traces calls with timing and arguments. X-ray vision for processes.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits syscall streams.

topics.name: Boot Sequence Simulator
topics.concept: Booting chains firmware, bootloader, kernel, and init with dependency ordering. The simulator steps through stages with timing. From power-on to login.
topics.data_idea: Boot flows derive from stage definitions.

topics.name: Init Dependency Resolver
topics.concept: Init systems order service startup from dependency graphs, parallelizing where possible. The resolver topologically sorts services with timeout handling. Boot, parallelized.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds service graphs.

topics.name: Kernel Module Dependency Checker
topics.concept: Kernel modules declare dependencies that modprobe resolves in order. The checker validates dependency graphs detecting cycles. Loading order, guaranteed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG wires module dependencies.

topics.name: File Descriptor Tracker
topics.concept: Every open file, socket, and pipe consumes a descriptor, and leaks exhaust the table. The tracker monitors open and close pairing flagging leaks. fds are finite.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG opens files with leaks.

topics.name: Inter Process Pipe Sim
topics.concept: Pipes stream bytes between processes with blocking semantics and buffer limits. The simulator models producer-consumer flow with capacity. Unix's simplest IPC.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG paces pipe IO.

topics.name: Shared Memory Simulator
topics.concept: Shared memory maps the same pages into multiple processes for the fastest IPC, needing external synchronization. The simulator shows mapping with semaphore guards. Speed with responsibility.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG accesses shared regions.
